title: Louisiana reports live BEAD service available to 104 Bossier Parish locations
publisher: Louisiana Office of Broadband Development and Connectivity
summary: ConnectLA reports that Nextlink activated a BEAD-funded fixed-wireless tower on May 1, 2026 and made gigabit-speed service available to 104 BEAD locations in Bossier Parish. Denominator: One tower in southern Bienville Parish and the 104 BEAD locations in Bossier Parish stated as receiving service availability, within a larger 7,460-location Nextlink subgrant.
